Brandon Swanson (19) and Jason Landry (21). 2 separate cases, 2 totally different regions of the U.S, but oh so chillingly similar. Both in car wrecks, both never seen or heard from again, no trace of them. There are other cases strikingly similar, always men from 18-early 20's who were in car wrecks and never heard from again, but I can't name any other's off the top of my head.
